notes.note: Delta-only review of the final Lane 2 merge at 38d5a42120a with foundation round two 0134b835eb2. Lite uses the exact shared channel mapper patch from PR 3788 commit 489e9077238 (shared blob ecef3f454d7877f9d3ca0bc8ca60f439e4f2e75c); beta becomes preview, permitted labels survive, omitted unknown falls back to source-checkout. Captured build provenance is the only input. Full remains pseudonymous, Lite identifier-free. Both Full acknowledgements reject internal agents; new notice/feedback writes do too. A real API/HTTP/state regression was red at 200 versus 403 before that guard and green after; final combined source passed 1529 tests in 13 focused files plus server-tests typecheck. Installation-age starts at first local telemetry observation, not historical package installation. The four requested mutation controls remain bound to a1a984762b4; later changes are helper reuse, consent copy and principal guards. Existing receiver deployment, UI/native, provider, store approval and release limitations are preserved, not newly qualified.
